description: This is a Java unit test class for the TestConnection class, testing JSON serialization, equality, immutability, and resource path retrieval.

classes.name: TestConnectionTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing various functionalities of TestConnection, including JSON serialization, equality, immutability, and resource path.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the TestConnection class correctly implements hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that instances of TestConnection are immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnection
methods.description: Ensures that creating a TestConnection with null connection argument throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that a TestConnection can be correctly reconstructed from its JSON representation.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that a TestConnection serializes to the correct JSON format.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the resource path provided by TestConnection is as expected (empty pointer).
